purpose: Canonical customer-facing Security Center contract for account security status, risk alerts, TOTP, GSL, devices, login history, anti-phishing code, and high-risk verification entry points.

compatibility.reuse_rule: SecurityLoginLogScreen may be linked from Security Center as device/login detail, but cannot replace the canonical overview.

business_rules: Only the highest-priority active alert is displayed at one time.
Dismissed unresolved alerts can reappear after 24 hours.
TOTP active status contributes 30 points to the security score; disable_pending contributes only 10 points.
Closing TOTP always enters a 24-hour GSL and TOTP remains valid during the pending period.
Changing email, changing phone, adding withdrawal address, and high-risk password change enter 24-hour GSL.
Withdrawal and new withdrawal address always require strong verification and cannot be DMP-disabled.
Trusted device may only waive low or selected medium-risk checks; it cannot waive high-risk financial or account recovery operations.
Current device/session cannot be revoked from device management.
Security Center must not force local PIN setup; local PIN remains optional unless the user explicitly locks the app.
All visible copy must use i18n keys and be represented in copy table before production release.

interactions.result: route to detail, open GSL cancel sheet, freeze contact path, or device detail according to alert type
interactions.failure_recovery: show API error with retry or support contact

interactions.result: open TOTP binding flow: app guidance, QR/manual key, 6-digit code, recovery codes, save confirmation
interactions.failure_recovery: invalid code error, locked state after configured failures

interactions.result: show high-risk confirmation, verify TOTP, create GSL pending change
interactions.failure_recovery: blocked when account frozen, invalid code, or existing pending change

interactions.result: verify TOTP or email OTP, cancel GSL, keep original setting active
interactions.failure_recovery: preserve pending change and show recoverable error

interactions.result: verify if required, revoke target session/token, refresh device list
interactions.failure_recovery: block current device and already-revoked sessions with stable error code

interactions.result: verify, update code immediately, send email and in-app notification
interactions.failure_recovery: reject unsafe content and preserve previous code

risk_rules: Critical account freeze and remote login blocked alerts override all other active alerts.
High-risk withdrawal, withdrawal address, TOTP disable, email/phone change, and high-risk remote login must never rely on email-only verification as a long-term policy.
Partner users follow normal account-security UI, with stricter risk policy for funds-related operations.
DMP can configure only non-mandatory scenarios; mandatory security scenarios are policy-locked.

forbidden: No page-local hardcoded colors, spacing, radius, typography, shadows, icons, or visible copy.
No page-local calculation of final risk decision.

blockers_before_production: OpenAPI request/response and backend persistence model must be approved.
Risk/compliance must confirm GSL, TOTP, remote login, and withdrawal verification thresholds.
High-risk English and Indonesian copy requires financial copy and UX Gate review.
Route /settings/security-center must be implemented and registered before UI release.
